Class Controller

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.Controller
public class Controller extends Object
The Controller class acts as the intermediary between the Model (logic) and the View (GUI). It handles user inputs, updates the model, and refreshes the view accordingly.

    • model

      private final Model model

      Invariant: Initialized in the constructor and must never be null.

      private final View view
      Reference to the graphical user interface.
      Invariant: Initialized in the constructor and must never be null.

    • controller

      private final Controller controller
      Self-reference to the controller instance. Used primarily to pass the controller context to anonymous inner classes or listeners.
      Invariant: Always refers to this.

    • currentClip

      private static Clip currentClip
      Static Clip object to handle background music playback.
      State: null if no music is loaded; otherwise holds the open audio stream.

    • turnTimer

      private static Timer turnTimer
      Swing Timer used to track the countdown for a player's turn.
      State: When running, triggers an ActionEvent every 1000ms (1 second).

    • timeLeft

      private int timeLeft
      Integer representing the seconds remaining in the current turn.
      Condition: Typically ranges from MAX_TURN_TIME down to 0 during an active turn.

    • MAX_TURN_TIME

      private static final int MAX_TURN_TIME
      Constant defining the maximum duration of a turn in seconds.
      Invariant: Fixed configuration value (Standard: 30 seconds).

  • Constructor Details

    • Controller

      public Controller(Model model, View view)
      Constructor for the Controller. Initializes the Model and View, sets up the Main Menu, and attaches initial listeners. Pre-condition: The Model and View objects must be instantiated and not null. Post-condition: The Controller is initialized, the View displays the Main Menu, and menu listeners are active.
      Parameters:
      model - The game logic instance.
      view - The game GUI instance.

  • Method Details

    • randomColor

      private static Color randomColor()
      Generates a random color within specific Hue/Saturation/Brightness bounds. Pre-condition: None. Post-condition: Returns a non-null Color object with pastel-like properties.
      Returns:
      A Color object representing a random color.

    • startTurnTimer

      public void startTurnTimer(String cmd, int time)
      Manages the countdown timer for the player's turn. Pre-condition: cmd must be a valid string ("Start", "Resume", or other). Post-condition: The previous timer (if any) is stopped. A new timer starts, updating the View every second.
      Parameters:
      cmd - The command instruction.
      time - The specific time to set if resuming (otherwise ignored).

    • playPlayerMusic

      public void playPlayerMusic()
      Loads and plays the specific audio track associated with the current player or game mode. Pre-condition: Audio files must exist in "assets/msc/". Post-condition: Previous audio stops. New audio loads, sets volume, and loops continuously.

    • AddMainMenuActionListeners

      public void AddMainMenuActionListeners()
      Adds ActionListeners to the buttons found in the Main Menu view. Pre-condition: The View is currently displaying the Main Menu components. Post-condition: Buttons 0, 1, and 2 (New Game/Load) are enabled, styled, and functional.

    • ImplementGameStartActions

      private void ImplementGameStartActions()
      Executes the logic to initialize the game board state. Pre-condition: Game mode and Player must be selected in the Model. Post-condition: Initial tiles are drawn, board counts updated, View switches to GameWindow, and music/timer start.

    • AddGameStartActionListeners

      public void AddGameStartActionListeners()
      Adds ActionListeners to the primary game control buttons. Pre-condition: The View is in the Game Window state. Post-condition: "Draw Tiles", "End Turn", and "Save - Exit" buttons function according to game rules.

    • AddBoardButtonsActionListeners

      public void AddBoardButtonsActionListeners()
      Adds ActionListeners to the interactive tile buttons on the board. Pre-condition: The board is populated with buttons. Post-condition: Clicking a board tile triggers "GetOneTileFromTheBoard" in Model and updates the View.

    • AddCardsButtonsActionListeners

      public void AddCardsButtonsActionListeners()
      Adds ActionListeners and MouseListeners to the character card buttons. Pre-condition: Player holds a list of CardTiles. Post-condition: Cards are clickable (if available) to activate effects, and show tooltips on hover.

    • AddGameOverActionListeners

      public void AddGameOverActionListeners()
      Adds ActionListeners to the Game Over screen elements. Pre-condition: The game has ended and the View displays the Game Over screen. Post-condition: The "Main Menu" button resets the Model/View and returns to the start.

    • AddHelpButtonActionListener

      public void AddHelpButtonActionListener()
      Adds functionality to the Help (?) button. Pre-condition: The Help button exists in the current view. Post-condition: Clicking it saves current state (if in game) and switches View to Help Screen.

    • AddGoBackButtonActionListener

      public void AddGoBackButtonActionListener()
      Adds functionality to the "Go Back" button within the Help screen. Pre-condition: The View is in the Help Screen state. Post-condition: Clicking returns the user to the Main Menu.

    • updateCardLabels

      private void updateCardLabels()
      Checks the state of the current player's character cards and updates text. Pre-condition: Player's inventory or board state may have changed. Post-condition: Card button labels are updated to "Available", "Active", or "Used".

    • showBagContent

      private void showBagContent()
      Updates the information panel label with bag contents. Pre-condition: The Model contains current bag data and player area info. Post-condition: The View's info label displays formatted HTML text with stats.

    • RemoveAllActionListeners

      private void RemoveAllActionListeners(JButton button)
      Utility method to remove all ActionListeners from a specific JButton. Pre-condition: The button may have existing listeners. Post-condition: The button has zero ActionListeners attached.
      Parameters:
      button - The JButton to clear listeners from.
